ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms equivalence evidence, review owners and the survival-only flag are declared; it does not analyze mutants.
offer: Require behavioral reasoning before marking a mutant equivalent. Survival can mean missing tests, so it cannot itself prove that a mutation changes no behavior.

minimal.reason: Record the behavioral reasoning that a mutant is equivalent. Survival alone could mean a missing test, so write the argument.

mid.reason: Name who reviews equivalence claims. An unreviewed claim hides test gaps, so assign reviewers.

maximal.reason: Set classifying by survival only to false. Treating every survivor as equivalent hides real unasserted behavior, so require evidence.
